text:
elaine: Quick ops note — planning a phased activation of the config `prefetch_cache_v2` in prod tonight at 01:00 UTC. Goal: enable region-by-region with automatic safe default fallback if errors spike. Need a deploy owner + 2 smoke checkers.

mike: I can own the deploy window. I'll be on-call for 01:00-02:30 UTC.

priya: I can run smoke checks for us (US + EU). What are the exact smoke steps?

elaine: Thanks both. Smoke checklist (short):
- confirm control-plane health (console + /health)
- run 3x perf sample requests to the flagged route (latency + error rate)
- validate cache hit ratio delta via /metrics pref.cache.hit_ratio
- quick end-to-end check on a staging customer route

jordan: I'll prep the toggle script and rollback snippet. Pasting here:
```bash
# enable for region eu-west-1
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' 
  https://config.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/prefetch_cache_v2/enable 
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","percentage":20}'

# rollback to safe default
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://config.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/prefetch_cache_v2/disable 
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1"}'
```

elaine: Ops plan:
- 01:00 UTC: enable 20% traffic in eu-west-1 (smoke for 15m)
- 01:20 UTC: if stable, lift to 80% in eu-west-1 + enable 20% in us-west-2
- 01:50 UTC: finish gating (80% global) or rollback if any measured regression > 3% error increase or 200ms p95 latency bump

mike: On rollback criteria — what's the exact metric thresholds we watch? I can wire alerts in Datadog now.

elaine: Primary signals:
- error rate (5xx) relative increase > 3% absolute
- p95 latency increase > 200ms over baseline
- pref.cache.hit_ratio drops > 10% and doesn't recover in 5m
- any customer-reported 500s on the flagged endpoints

priya: Got it. I'll run the perf script and annotate the results in the thread. Do we need a canary account to target?

jordan: Yes, use tenant `canary-ops-3` for the first 20% stage. After that we flip region-level percentages.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment job #deploy-2118765432 created — window 2026-03-18 01:00:00 UTC. Notifying on-call.

mike: I'll be in the greenroom 00:55 UTC. Can someone watch infra logs for mem/cpu spikes? @jordan?

jordan: Happy to. I'll tail the runtime logs and post snippets if anything odd shows up.

elaine: Rollback readiness checklist:
- admin key holder present (mike)
- rollback command prepped (jordan pasted)
- incident channel #incidents on standby (notify if we hit thresholds)
- maintainers on pager for 30m post-final enable

priya: I'll capture a baseline (latency + hit_ratio) now and post numbers so we have immediate comparison.

mike: thumbs up. tagging @oncall infra to keep an eye: @infra-oncall?

deploy-bot: infra-oncall has been paged for watch duty.

elaine: Perfect. Final ask: if anyone notices persistent 4xx/5xx on the flagged route, run the rollback command immediately and ping #incidents. Otherwise we'll proceed with the phased plan. :thumbsup:

priya: Baseline posted: p95 180ms, error rate 0.9%, pref.cache.hit_ratio 84%. Will update after stage 1.

mike: See you all in the greenroom. If all good, I'll confirm the lift steps in-thread as we go.

elaine: Thanks team — I'll keep this thread as the single source for decisions.
